ItemID: 1; Title: haisstronica 160PCS Yellow Heat Shrink Spade Connectors,AWG 12-10 Heat Shrink Spade Terminlas Kit,Male and Female Electrical Quick Disconnect Wire Connectors; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Insulated quick disconnects would be useful for repair wiring alongside my mechanical fastener supplies, provided the wire gauge matches.
ItemID: 2; Title: Joywayus 3 Way (T-Port) Shut Off 1/2"G Thread Ball Valve with 3/4" Hose Barb Lever Handle Brass Fitting One Switch; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a hose-routing project that needs this specific valve and fitting size.
ItemID: 3; Title: VIGRUE 310 Pcs #6 1/2'' to 1'' #8 1/2'' to 1-1/2'' Wood Screws Black Oxide Coated Stainless Steel Flat Head Phillips Drywall Screw Assortment Kit, Self Tapping Screws Kit in 8 Sizes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Screw assortments fit my workshop interests, but I already have a substantial wood screw kit and would skip another this time.
ItemID: 4; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Disposable gloves would be useful for messy workshop tasks, though I would check their suitability before using them with resin or solvents.
ItemID: 5; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like measurement tools, but I have no current application requiring this particular pressure range and connection.
ItemID: 6; Title: M6-1.0 x 16mm (30 PCS) Countersunk Head Socket Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 10.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, DIN 7991; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my interest in metric fastening, but I would wait until a project specifically calls for this length and countersunk head.
ItemID: 7; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These could complement my 1/4-20 rivet nuts, with a broad head useful for fastening thin material if the required length matches.
ItemID: 8; Title: Adhesive Guru Spray Foam Gun Cleaner 15,8 oz, Expanding Foam Gun Cleaner, Insulation Polyurethane and PU Sealant Remover for Pro Dispensing Gun, 1 Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My adhesive projects have involved tape and epoxy; I have no current need for expanding foam gun cleaner.
ItemID: 9; Title: Joywayus Hex Nipple 1/4"NPT Male x 1/4"NPT Male Threaded Stainless Steel 304 Threaded Nipple Pipe Fittings for Brew Kit Home Piping (Pack of 5); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently assembling a piping setup that requires these threaded fittings.
ItemID: 10; Title: 2PACK Stainless Mesh Screen 12”X24”(305mmX610mm), 20 Mesh 304 Steel Woven Wire Mesh, 1mm Hole Sturdy Easy to Cut Never Rust by Valchoose; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Cut-to-size mesh could suit a future fabrication project, but I would skip it until I have a specific use and opening-size requirement.
